## Checklist

- [ ] Every step is marked 🟢, 🟡, or 🔴.  Every 🔴 warning comes before its step.  Every 🟡 step says how to undo it.
- [ ] On-screen labels are quoted exactly, in bold.
- [ ] Commands that use `sudo`, write system files, or erase anything are explained.  Nothing pipes a download into a shell.
- [ ] No personal details:  names, usernames, hostnames, addresses, serial numbers, disk IDs, or real home folder paths.
- [ ] Scripts:  `shellcheck` is clean, and I ran `--help` and `--dry-run`.
- [ ] I've said what I tested on, and marked anything untested as untested.
